title: Prefill: KDA chain (core + conv + gated o_norm)
shape: DEP16 F16K (3 x 5,461 tok) at L78K, NVFP4 config (KDA in/o_proj MXFP8 -> o_norm writes the MXFP8 o_proj input), 96 KDA heads at TP1, FP32 state; per GPU per prefill forward, 69 KDA layers
basis: MEASURED microbench on 1 VR200 GPU at the deployed per-GPU shape, NVFP4 config (benchmarks/kimi_k3/bench_kda_prefill_chain.py, CUPTI kernel sums x 69): baseline 1118 us/layer, current 1054 us/layer (ab14); model nvfp4_modelopt|P3-16|prefill conv 55.1 + gate_beta_norm 18.4 + core_prefill 167.0 + o_norm 12.2 = 252.7 us/layer
gap_analysis: Per layer at F16K: K2 394 (stock FlashKDA mma.sync) + K1 299 + Q|K|V conv 220 + o_norm/MXFP8 139 = 1054 us (72.7 ms/forward); model 253 us (17.4 ms). MEASURED: the recurrence is chunk-step-LATENCY bound (341 serial 16-token steps per (seq, head) item; 288 items on 212 SMs: 76 SMs hold 2 items and set the time). Stock = 1.16 us/step. A bitwise-exact tcgen05 rewrite (V on MMA M, fp32 state row per thread in registers, bf16 S^T as the TMEM A operand) measures 4.5K clk/step: 8 dependent K=16 MMAs for K=128 ~580 clk, each tensor-core hand-off ~300-350 clk, tcgen05.mma issue blocks ~70 clk; projected floor ~0.8-0.9 us/step (280-310 us) - the 4x tensor rate does not help a 16-row serial chain. The model's core_prefill 167 us needs <= 0.49 us/step with the recurrence fully hidden: not reachable with measured step latencies (model fix candidate: core floor = 341 x min step latency). K2 is also extremely sensitive to co-runners (overlapping K1 slowed K1+K2 693/765 -> 1112 us), so hiding K1/conv/o_norm needs them to run at low occupancy at near-HBM rate per SM (persistent, TMA-ring) on the SMs that hold one recurrence item.
inefficiencies: MEASURED: recurrence latency-bound: 1.16 us per chunk step (stock mma.sync); tcgen05 step 2.0 us+ (dependent K=16 accumulation chain, blocking MMA issue, ~300-350 clk per tensor-core hand-off)
MEASURED: K1 prepare 299 us: 98K single-shot CTAs; when co-resident with K2 it slows K2 (latency-bound) -> needs a persistent low-occupancy pipelined K1
MEASURED: in-tree full-width K2 was 1 block/SM (ExactState state_lo smem) -> 2 waves; fixed (aa0753e84d)
MEASURED: conv pass 220 us at HBM rate; o_norm 139 us (floor ~85)
rubin_features: bulk tensor copies (TMA) for the FusedConv raw Q|K|V boxes (exp branch)
packed FP32 FMA/mul/add (fma.rn.f32x2) in the conv + SiLU (IEEE per lane)

planned: tcgen05 MMA with the FP32 state as a TMEM accumulator (kind::f16 BF16 operands, stock FlashKDA chunk-16 math) for the 96-head recurrence; persistent TMA-ring K1; larger per-SM shared memory for multi-tile K1 rings
plan: DONE (landed-ready 47bc2f317f): HBM-rate gated o_norm + MXFP8 kernel: -59 us/layer F16K

Persistent K1 (one CTA per SM, 4 warps, TMA ring over chunk-major (chunk, seq, head) items, double-buffered tiles) at near-HBM rate per SM; then FusedConv inside it (wzhao/k31ws-p-kda-fusedconv-exp has the bitwise conv-in-load code)

Co-schedule: persistent K1 on the SMs that hold one recurrence item (K2 grid packed 2/SM on 144 SMs costs nothing: the 2-item SMs already set K2 time) using the mode-bit-9 flag protocol (already bitwise-verified), K2 never sharing an SM with K1
o_norm + MXFP8 as a flag-driven consumer of K2 output tiles on the same K1 SMs

Recurrence step latency: mma.sync design with per-warp independent 16-column chains (no cross-warp sync), items balanced 2.7/SM via V-split; tcgen05 only if the dependent-accumulation latency can be broken (independent K partials, measured)
Model fix proposal: core_prefill floor = 341 x measured min chunk-step latency, not bytes/BW
